The '''Bastal Family Farmhouse''' was a [[Farm/Legends|ranch]] located on [[Kessan's Landing]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], during the [[Third Galactic War]]. [[The Curator]], a reclusive [[Collector/Legends|collector]] of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], lived in a secret subterranean [[Curator's Bunker|storehouse]] located underneath the Bastal Family Farmhouse.<ref name="TOR:EotP" />
